paragraphs: The X5 xDrive40i is a current-generation petrol MHEV variant using BMW's B58 3.0-litre inline-six engine. We confirm the exact vehicle specification by registration before quoting so the rebuild and replacement parts match the vehicle.
about.boldParagraph: The X5 xDrive40i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because BMW X5 xDrive40i can use the B58 engine code, fitting the wrong replacement risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (B58) via registration or VIN

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X5 xDrive40i quote - it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
